record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Determine how the length of the linear strand in the minimal graded free resolution of S/I is related to other invariants of S/I.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $k$, graded in the standard way with $\deg(x_i) = 1$, and let $I \subseteq S$ be a homogeneous ideal. Consider the minimal graded free resolution of the quotient $S/I$:
$$\cdots \to F_2 \to F_1 \to F_0 \to S/I \to 0, \qquad F_i = \bigoplus_j S(-j)^{\beta_{i,j}(S/I)}.$$
The linear strand of this resolution is the subcomplex consisting of those summands $S(-(i+d-1))^{\beta_{i,i+d-1}(S/I)}$ in homological degree $i$, where $d$ is the smallest degree of a minimal generator of $I$; equivalently, it records the Betti numbers $\beta_{i,i+d-1}(S/I)$. The length of the linear strand is the largest $i$ such that $\beta_{i,i+d-1}(S/I) \neq 0$.

Determine how the length of the linear strand of the minimal graded free resolution of $S/I$ is related to other homological and algebraic invariants of $S/I$ (such as projective dimension, regularity, depth, dimension, Hilbert function, or invariants of the generating degrees of $I$).
artifact.category_tag: Minimal free resolutions and linear strands
artifact.status_search_result: This is posed as an open-ended problem about relating the length of the linear strand of a minimal free resolution to other invariants of $S/I$. While specific results exist (e.g., bounds via regularity, results for edge ideals and componentwise linear ideals, and the linear strand of monomial/Stanley–Reisner ideals studied by Eisenbud–Fløystad–Schreyer, Herzog–Hibi, and others), no general structural answer is known, and the problem is broadly phrased and remains open.
